# Video brief

Original request R1: Show new users how to keep a favorite near the top and change it later.

## Decisions
- Proposed: 30-60 seconds, narrated promotional video. Owner has not accepted this.
- Goal: teach the real pin/unpin action; product supports one pinned favorite at a time.
- Authentic product capture can show both pin and unpin; no footage is attached here.
- Open: audience, sound mode, exact duration, tone, call to action and visual direction.

## Checks
No media playback, listening, visual previews or independent review has occurred.
